name: How do I choose between a condo and a single-family home for a vacation property?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between a condo and a single-family home for a vacation property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between a condo and a single-family home for a vacation property involves weighing maintenance responsibilities, amenities, and community rules. Condos often come with lower exterior maintenance but include HOA fees that cover common areas and amenities like pools or gyms, common in places like Williams Island or Brickell Key. Single-family homes offer more privacy and land but require more personal upkeep. A practical tradeoff is considering the lifestyle you desire versus the level of involvement you want in property management. If you prefer a lock-and-leave option with amenities, a condo might be a better fit.
